title: One Minute Remaining
description: Ronnie's washing machine has said one minute remaining since Tuesday. Barry is not sympathetic.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry. <p:0.3> I gotta talk to you about my washing machine.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ohhh no. Okay. Here we go.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It says one minute remaining. One minute! So I wait. I stand there. Like an idiot.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Ten minutes later, Barry. Ten. Still says one minute.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Maybe it's just a long minute.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It is lying to me, Barry. Right to my face.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It does not have a face, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's got a little screen. That's basically a face.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So I come back an hour later. A whole hour. You know what it said?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: One minute.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: ONE MINUTE! <p:0.3> It's been the same minute since Tuesday, Barry!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay, that's not a washing machine. That's a hostage situation.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So I unplugged it. Pulled the plug right out of the wall. Took my power back.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Good. Smart. Show it who's boss.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Plugged it back in an hour later. <p:0.3> You wanna guess what it said?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Please don't say one minute.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: One. <p:0.2> Minute.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It remembered. It was waiting for you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now I'm scared to open it. What if it's still on one minute?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Then you wait, Ronnie. <p:0.3> It's only a minute.
